decisions.reason: Designs paste_image/paste_file with the (n) suffix before the extension, smallest-free-number until unused, sequential per-batch reservation added to the live set, renaming tagged to the paste acquisition path only before insertion/record creation, with drop and picker keeping real names.

Identifies the live composer occurrence set as the authoritative taken source, explains the records subscription retiring entries on momentary empty snapshots while attachments stay live, and adds a batch working set for in-flight items; records kept for rendering only.

Cites the cached response (x-cache HIT, age 178, missing v0.2.10/v0.2.11, top v0.2.9) and renderCurrentChip printing the fetched tag; the corrected rule compares remote to running PLUGIN_VERSION semantically, shows the remote tag only when newer, the running version otherwise, and treats older reads as unknown.

Proposes single, repeated, and same-batch pastes with exact expected names, alive-subscription/empty-records cases where a live occurrence still blocks the name, drop/picker scoping guards, and chip tests for older, equal, and newer remote tags against the running build.

Orders bump → inlined PLUGIN_VERSION update → verification with a mechanical equality guard against package.json, runs node --check on shipped lib artifacts plus behavioral suites, and explains delivery via profile install/update, host restart for cached client bundles, and hard refresh, with no host-side update endpoint.
